changes.title: Call or book from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage is a 2009 layout that shrinks on a phone, and 281.367.5959 can't be tapped. The concept puts a tap to call button and an appointment request at the top of every screen.

changes.title: Your 4.7 Google rating up front.
changes.text: You have 88 Google reviews, but the site shows none of them. The concept brings your rating and real customer quotes onto the homepage.

changes.title: The shuttle and free brake checks, where people look.
changes.text: Your customer shuttle and free brake inspections sit on separate inner pages today. The concept leads with them, next to every service you offer.
